meta.review_notes: Complete re-analysis based on 49,649 character privacy policy. Key findings: extensive ad tracking across on/off platform, data shared with Facebook/Google ad platforms, AI model training on user content including body type technology, age verification uses facial estimation and government ID matching, log data retained 25 months.

app.name: Pinterest: Lifestyle Ideas
app.description: Visual discovery and bookmarking platform for lifestyle ideas, DIY projects, recipes, fashion, home decor, and creative inspiration.

verdict.one_liner: Pinterest tracks your activity on and off the platform to show you personalized ads, shares data with Facebook and Google, and uses your content to train AI models.
verdict.summary: Pinterest is a popular visual discovery platform that collects extensive data about your interests and behavior. It tracks your activity both on Pinterest and on other websites through the Pinterest Tag, shares data with advertising partners like Facebook and Google, and uses your Pins and photos to train machine learning models including generative AI. While you can opt out of personalized ads and delete your account, the platform is heavily focused on data collection for advertising purposes.
verdict.recommendation_reason: Pinterest engages in extensive cross-site tracking, shares data with major ad platforms, and uses your content for AI training. Consider whether these privacy trade-offs are worth the inspirational content.

red.title: Your offsite activity tracked for ads
red.plain_english: Pinterest tracks your activity on other websites that have Pinterest features (like the Save button) and receives information about your visits to advertiser sites through the Pinterest Tag to customize ads.

red.title: Data shared with Facebook Ads and Google Marketing Platform
red.plain_english: Pinterest discloses your cookie IDs, IP address, and hashed email address to third parties including Facebook Ads and Google Marketing Platform to advertise Pinterest to you on other sites.

red.title: Your Pins train AI and machine learning models
red.plain_english: Pinterest uses your images and activity to train machine learning models including body type technology and generative AI features, regardless of when Pins were posted.

red.title: Age verification may use facial recognition
red.plain_english: Pinterest conducts age verification that may include facial age estimation and matching your face against a government ID.

red.title: Your activity logs kept for 25 months
red.plain_english: Pinterest generally keeps log data for 25 months to provide services, improve features, and deliver targeted ads.

green.title: You can opt out of personalized ads
green.plain_english: You can opt out of targeted advertising and data sharing for ad purposes in your Privacy and Data Settings menu.

green.title: Full account deletion available
green.plain_english: You can delete your account and data through settings by selecting Delete your data and account.

green.title: Strong rights for EU/UK/Swiss users
green.plain_english: Residents of the EEA, UK, and Switzerland have GDPR rights including access, portability, objection to processing, and the right to lodge complaints with supervisory authorities.

green.title: Global Privacy Control signals respected
green.plain_english: For users in certain U.S. states who have enabled opt-out preference signals like Global Privacy Control, Pinterest will respect this preference.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: You can optionally use your camera for photo search to find similar items. This requires opting in through your device settings.
categories.detail: Camera access is optional and used only for photo search feature where you can take a photo of an item and find similar Pins. Requires explicit opt-in through device operating system settings.
categories.policy_excerpt: Allow searching with photos, if you choose. For example, if you take a photo of a pair of shoes or a piece of furniture you like, you can ask us to show you similar items. You can opt in to this in your device operating system settings.
concerns: Camera data handling not fully detailed

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: Pinterest infers your approximate location from your IP address continuously, even if you don't share precise location. Precise location is optional via device settings.
categories.detail: IP address used to infer approximate location continuously. Precise location optional via device settings and used to customize experience (e.g., showing nearby retailers). Location data also collected from photo metadata.
categories.policy_excerpt: We use your IP address to infer your approximate location, even if you don't choose to share your precise location... Depending on where you live, and with your consent, identify your precise location and customize your experience on our Services. For example, if we know that you're near a retailer we may show you that retailer's Pins.
concerns: IP location inferred continuously without opt-out
Location used for ad targeting

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: If you choose to sync contacts, Pinterest accesses contacts stored on your device to help you find which of your contacts are on Pinterest.
categories.detail: Contact syncing is optional. If enabled, Pinterest accesses contacts stored on your device and processes information about contacts who are Pinterest users. Also used to help friends find you via email search.
categories.policy_excerpt: If you previously chose to sync your contacts with your account, we will continue to process certain information about your contacts who are Pinterest users to help you find one another on our Services... If you choose to sync your contacts with your Pinterest account, we will access contacts stored on your device to help you find out if your contacts are on our Services.
concerns: Contact data processed on servers
Continues processing if previously synced

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: Pinterest collects the images, photos, and content you upload, save, or create on the platform. Public content is visible to anyone.
categories.detail: Visual content collected when you save, upload, or create Pins and boards. Public boards and Pins accessible to anyone. Comments and descriptions also collected. Photos may contain location metadata.
categories.policy_excerpt: We collect information when you save or upload Pins, photos, or other content, interact with Pins or other content (for example, commenting or adding a Pin)... Your Picsart profile and the posts you make are publicly accessible, which means anyone can see your profile photo, name, and description about yourself if you add that information.
concerns: Public content visible to all users
Photos may contain location metadata

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Pinterest shares your data with advertisers, Facebook Ads, Google Marketing Platform, service providers, law enforcement, corporate affiliates, and may share in business transactions.
categories.detail: Data shared with: third-party advertising platforms (Facebook Ads, Google Marketing Platform), advertisers and partners for ad targeting and measurement, service providers (security, analytics), law enforcement when required, corporate family of companies, and parties involved in mergers/acquisitions. Public content available via APIs.
categories.policy_excerpt: we disclose information such as cookie IDs, your IP address, or a hashed version of your email address to third parties, such as Facebook Ads, Google Marketing Platform, and others... we share data for advertising and related purposes, including showing you ads about Pinterest on third-party services, enabling partners to show you ads both on and off Pinterest
concerns: Data shared with major ad platforms
Offsite advertising based on Pinterest data
Information shared with advertisers for lead ads
Data transferred in business transactions

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: Pinterest collects your name, email, birthday, gender, country, interests, and preferred language. Business accounts may optionally include race and ethnicity information.
categories.detail: Account information includes name, email, birthday, gender, country, interests, preferred language. Optional demographic data for business accounts includes race/ethnicity for Creator promotion purposes. Third-party account data used if you link Facebook or Google accounts.
categories.policy_excerpt: When you join our Services, we collect information like your name, email address, birthday, gender, country of residence, your interests, and preferred language. If you have a business account, depending on where you live, you may also have the option to add race and ethnicity information to your profile.
concerns: Optional race/ethnicity data for business accounts
Extensive profile data collected

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: Pinterest tracks your activity on and off the platform to build a profile of your interests and show you personalized ads. They receive data about your visits to advertiser websites and activity on sites with Pinterest features.
categories.detail: Behavioral tracking includes: onsite activity (Pins clicked, searches, boards created), offsite activity (websites visited with Pinterest Tag or Save button), inferences about interests and preferences (e.g., education, professional experience), data from advertisers and partners about your activity, cross-device tracking. Activities may be considered targeted advertising, sharing, or selling under US state laws.
categories.policy_excerpt: we customize the ads we show you by identifying your interests based on your onsite and offsite activities, as well as by using information we receive from ad partners or other third parties... activity on websites you visit that incorporate Pinterest features (like the Save button)... we make inferences about you and your preferences
concerns: Extensive cross-site tracking via Pinterest Tag
Activity on partner websites monitored
Inferences made about personal characteristics
Considered selling/sharing under US state laws

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: Children under 13 are not allowed to use Pinterest. If you are in a jurisdiction with a higher age requirement, you must meet that age to consent to data processing.
categories.detail: 13+ age requirement (or higher if local law requires). Age verification includes facial age estimation and matching against government ID. No specific detail on how underage users are detected beyond this.
categories.policy_excerpt: Children under 13 are not allowed to use Pinterest. If you are based in a state or country with an older age requirement, you may only use the Services if you are at or over the age at which you can provide consent to data processing.
concerns: Age verification relies partly on self-reporting

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: Pinterest logs your IP address, browser type, activity on websites with Pinterest features, search terms, and which Pins you interact with. Log data is kept for 25 months.
categories.detail: Log data includes: IP address, browser type and settings, date/time of access, activity on third-party sites with Pinterest features (Save button), search terms, Pin interactions, boards created, comments. Retained for 25 months for service provision, safety, product improvement, and ad delivery.
categories.policy_excerpt: This log data includes, for example, your Internet Protocol (IP) address, activity on websites you visit that incorporate Pinterest features (like the 'Save' button) browser type and settings, and the date and time of when you accessed the Services... We generally keep log data for a period of 25 months
concerns: Activity tracked across websites with Pinterest widgets
25-month log data retention
Detailed interaction logging

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: Pinterest collects information about your device including type, operating system, network provider, settings, and unique device identifiers.
categories.detail: Device information collected includes: type of device, operating system, network service provider, settings, unique device identifiers. Used for service provision, security, advertising, and cross-device tracking.
categories.policy_excerpt: We collect information about the device you use to access our Services, including the type of device, operating system, network service provider, settings, and unique device identifiers.
concerns: Unique device identifiers collected
Used for advertising and cross-device tracking

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: Pinterest conducts age verification which may include facial age estimation and matching your face against a government ID.
categories.detail: Age verification processes may include facial age estimation and matching user's face against government ID. Used for safety and compliance. Body type technology is also used (trained on Pins) but this is not biometric data of users.
categories.policy_excerpt: Conduct age verification, as appropriate. This may include facial age estimation and matching your face against a government ID.
concerns: Facial recognition may be used for age verification
Government ID matching involves sensitive biometric processing

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: If you submit information via lead ads (e.g., to sign up for an advertiser's mailing list), Pinterest shares that information with the advertiser.
categories.detail: Financial/payment data handled through lead ads where you submit information to advertisers (e.g., mailing list signups). Pinterest shares this information with the advertiser as described on the form. No mention of direct payment processing by Pinterest.
categories.policy_excerpt: Lead ads. If you submit information via a lead ad form (for example, to sign up for an advertiser's mailing list or for a consultation), we will share that information with the advertiser as described on the form.
concerns: Lead ad information shared with advertisers
Limited visibility into what financial data advertisers collect

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You can delete your account and request data deletion through settings. Some data may be retained for legal or safety reasons, and correspondence about data requests is kept for 2 years.
categories.detail: Deletion available in settings (Delete your data and account). GDPR rights for EEA/UK/Swiss users: access, correction, deletion, restriction, portability, objection. Some data retained for legal obligations, litigation, safety investigations. Data subject request correspondence retained 2 years. Complaint data retained while being resolved.
categories.policy_excerpt: You can have your information deleted. In your settings, select 'Delete your data and account' and follow the instructions... We retain correspondence relating to data subject requests under GDPR for two years, in case those requests are not resolved and this correspondence is required in order to handle any resulting complaints.
concerns: Some data retained for legal/safety reasons
Request correspondence kept for 2 years
Data shared with partners may not be deleted

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Pinterest may change its policy at any time and continued use counts as acceptance. Significant changes may be notified by email or prominent notice.
categories.detail: Policy changes posted on policy page. Continued use after changes equals acceptance of new policy. Significant changes may receive more prominent notice such as email. No specific advance notice period stated.
categories.policy_excerpt: If you continue to use Pinterest after those changes are in effect, the new policy applies to you. If the changes are significant, we may provide a more prominent notice, such as by sending you an email.
concerns: Continued use = automatic acceptance
No specific advance notice period
